rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is wearing clothes.

example.english: I’m dressed in work clothes today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 saam1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for food or another thing that has been prepared and is ready to use.

example.english: The salad is dressed and ready to eat.
example.traditional: 沙律已經準備好，可以食喇。
example.jyutping: saa1 leot6 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 ho2 ji5 sik6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for food whose seasoning or dressing has been prepared.

example.english: The salad is dressed, so there’s no need to add more sauce.
example.traditional: 沙律已經調好味，唔使再加醬。
example.jyutping: saa1 leot6 ji5 ging1 tiu4 hou2 mei6 m4 sai2 zoi3 gaa1 zoeng3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something has undergone some treatment or processing.

example.english: These are dressed ingredients—you can cook them as soon as you open the packet.
example.traditional: 呢啲係處理過嘅食材，開袋就可以煮喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 cyu5 lei5 gwo3 ge3 sik6 coi4 hoi1 doi6 zau6 ho2 ji5 zyu2 laa3
